general.title: General
general.notesNote: Show what each setting does under its name, instead of behind the (i).

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.shownNote: Drag to reorder, or use the arrows. Settings stays in the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar.
sidebar.allShown: Every page is in the sidebar.
sidebar.railNote: Automatic folds it on laptop-width screens. Press [ to fold or open it anywhere.
sidebar.resetNote: Back to Home, Story, Play, Puzzles, Arena, Coach and Profile, in that order.

language.title: Language
language.note: The language of menus, buttons and messages. Lesson text follows when a translation exists.

display.title: Board & pieces
display.preview: Preview of the board with your settings

staunton.name: Staunton
staunton.note: Polished tournament pieces, made for Torre.

clay.name: Clay
clay.note: Soft, rounded pieces with a drawn outline.

classic.name: Classic
classic.note: Flat, high-contrast pieces. Easiest to read at small sizes.

board.title: Board colours
board.coordinatesNote: Files and ranks along the board's edge.
board.lastMoveNote: Tint the two squares of the move just played.
board.legalDotsNote: Dots on the squares a picked-up piece can reach.
board.animationNote: How a moved piece slides to its square.
board.dragNote: When off, move by clicking a piece and then its square.
board.autoQueenNote: Skip the promotion picker. Switch this off to underpromote.

sound.title: Sound
sound.muteNote: Silences sound effects, music and the coach.
sound.masterNote: Turns effects, music and the coach up or down together.
sound.effectsNote: Moves, right and wrong answers, and the fanfare when you finish.
sound.moveSoundNote: The sound of a piece landing. Other effects still play with None.
sound.musicNote: A quiet loop that dips while the coach is talking.
sound.musicVolumeNote: Only while background music is on.
sound.hiddenNote: While Torre's tab is hidden, the music pauses and effects stay silent.

voice.title: Coach & voice
voice.speaksNote: The coach reads lessons aloud and reacts to your puzzles.
voice.speedNote: Recordings and your browser's voice both follow it.
voice.dipNote: How far the background music drops while the coach talks.
voice.captionsNote: Show the coach's words at the bottom of the screen while it speaks.
voice.rookyNote: Rooky reads the Coach briefing and each new game recap aloud when they open.
voice.reviewNote: Stepping through a reviewed game, the coach says what each move was.
voice.quietNote: While you play, the coach stays silent and only speaks when you ask: no quips after captures or checks.
voice.heading: Voice packs
voice.note: Recorded coach voices sound natural and work offline, in a female or a male voice. Without the chosen voice's pack, the coach uses the other recorded voice, then your browser's.
voice.offline: Voice packs can't be listed right now. Check your connection.
voice.none: No voice packs are available yet.

learning.title: Learning & puzzles
learning.hardNote: Lessons and puzzles offer no hints and never show the answer. You work every move out yourself.
learning.helpNote: What a puzzle offers when you are stuck. Hard mode offers neither.
learning.autoNextNote: After a clean solve, the next puzzle opens by itself.
learning.ratingsNote: Your rating and how much each puzzle changed it, while you solve.
learning.blindfoldNote: Puzzles show the squares only; you solve from memory.
learning.playBlindfoldNote: Games against bots show the squares only, until the game ends.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.autoNote: Stockfish evaluates each position in Games and Explore.
analysis.depthNote: How long the engine thinks about each position. Deep is slower and stronger.
analysis.linesNote: How many lines the engine panel lists.
analysis.evalBarNote: The bar beside the board that shows who is better.
analysis.bestNote: A gold arrow for Stockfish's choice.
analysis.nextNote: A grey arrow for the move played next in the game.
analysis.controlNote: Tint squares by which side attacks them.
analysis.background: Analyze new games in the background
analysis.backgroundNote: Imported games are reviewed by Stockfish on their own, and your mistakes become drills and puzzles.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.sizeNote: Text, buttons and the board, a step larger.
accessibility.motionNote: Reduced keeps pieces and pages still. System follows your device's setting.
accessibility.contrastNote: Light and dark squares far apart, for low vision. Also under Board & pieces.
accessibility.paletteNote: Colour-blind safe uses blue and orange in place of green and red.
accessibility.announceNote: A screen reader reads each move as it lands on the board.
accessibility.typedNote: A box under the board takes moves like e4, Nf3 or O-O.

data.title: Data
data.resetNote: Every setting goes back to its default. Your language, games, stars and progress stay.
data.resetDone: Settings are back to their defaults.
data.backupNote: Save your settings, stars and progress from this browser as a file. Games and puzzles are kept by the studio.
data.restoreNote: Replace what this browser keeps with a backup file. The page reloads.
data.notBackup: That file is not a Torre backup.
data.storageNote: About {{size}} KB of settings and progress.

progress.title: Progress
progress.starsNote_one: {{count}} ★ earned against bots, kept in this browser. Awards and puzzle progress are not affected.
progress.starsNote_other: {{count}} ★ earned against bots, kept in this browser. Awards and puzzle progress are not affected.

about.title: About
about.unavailable: The studio could not be reached, so its details are not available.
about.dataNote: Your games, analysis, puzzles and engines live here.
about.copyBlocked: The browser did not allow copying.
about.noEngines: No engines are installed yet. Add one under Engines.

keys.step: Step back and forward through moves
keys.clear: Clear arrows and circles drawn on the board

uses.pythonChess: Chess rules, PGN and talking to engines
uses.fsrs: When missed puzzles and drills come back

ai.title: AI coach
ai.providerNote: Ollama runs a model on this computer for free. The others are online services: they need your own API key.
ai.providerNoteHosted: The coach runs on an AI service of your choice, with your own API key. You pay the service directly, usually a few cents a month.
ai.keyNote: Your key is kept with your Torre data and is only used for the coach.
ai.keyStale: {{name}} did not accept the saved key. Remove it and save a new one.
ai.modelsAfterKey: Save a key to see this provider's models.
ai.ollamaMissing: No local models yet. Install Ollama from ollama.com, run "ollama pull qwen3:8b", then come back.
ai.currentAuto: The coach picked {{model}} on its own.
ai.dialogText: Rooky's written advice comes from an AI model. Pick where it runs; you can change it any time in Settings.
